relations.subject: Mari Albert Johan van Manen
relations.evidence: only 1909 (not 1899) moved to India as the secretary of C. W. Leadbeater

relations.subject: Mari Albert Johan van Manen
relations.evidence: In 1909-16 he was second Librarian in Adyar Library

relations.subject: Mari Albert Johan van Manen
relations.evidence: In 1918-21 Librarian of the Imperial Library in Calcutta.

relations.subject: Mari Albert Johan van Manen
relations.role: Assistant in charge of the Anthropological Section
relations.evidence: From 1922 Assistant in charge of the Anthropological Section of the Indian Museum, Calcutta, for rearranging its Tibetan collections

relations.subject: Mari Albert Johan van Manen
relations.evidence: also a member of the Senate of Calcutta University.

relations.subject: Mari Albert Johan van Manen
relations.evidence: In 1923-39 General Secretary of the A.S.B. and editor of the JASB and MASB.
